matrix-modeling-bikes.alt: Two circles, Station A and Station B. A loop on A is labeled 0.8 and an arrow from A to B is labeled 0.2; an arrow from B to A is labeled 0.3 and a loop on B is labeled 0.7. Each day a bike at A stays with chance 0.8 or moves to B with chance 0.2, and a bike at B moves to A with chance 0.3 or stays with chance 0.7.
